body:
Goal: create the website/ Fumadocs project per spec §3, §3.1, §3.2, §3.3, §4 (placeholders), §7.10, §7.11 and the packaging guard in §8.

Do:
1. Scaffold with the §3.2 command (create-fumadocs-app@16.2.18). If a flag is rejected, use --help equivalents and name them in the PR description.
2. Pin every dependency exactly: fumadocs-core 16.17.1, fumadocs-ui 16.17.1, fumadocs-mdx 15.4.7, next 16.4.0, react 19.3.0, react-dom 19.3.0, mermaid 12.1.0, next-themes 0.4.6 (dependencies); next-validate-link 1.6.7 and scaffold tooling at their lockfile-resolved versions (devDependencies). No ^ or ~. If any table version is unavailable, stop and ask the owner. engines.node "22.x" (bounded so Vercel, which takes the version from engines and overrides the dashboard, builds on 22 not 24; spec §3 Node row); website/.nvmrc = 22.19.0; root package.json engines stays ">=22.19.0". Commit website/package-lock.json.
3. next.config.mjs per §3.1: default server output — no output, basePath, trailingSlash or images.unoptimized; only createMDX() and reactStrictMode: true; no env vars. Routes: app/(home)/page.tsx minimal landing linking /docs; docs at /docs. Search route app/api/search/route.ts: Orama server search GET (createSearchAPI('advanced', { indexes }) from fumadocs-core/search/server) with indexes built exactly as spec §3.1: source.getPages().filter(p => !p.url.includes('/docs/project/design-history/')).map(p => ({ id: p.url, url: p.url, title: p.data.title, description: p.data.description, structuredData: p.data.structuredData })); createFromSource is forbidden (cannot exclude pages); client uses the default Fumadocs search dialog (fetches /api/search). OG route app/og/docs/[...slug]/route.tsx with ImageResponse from next/og (scaffold --og-image next-og; do NOT install takumi-js) and generateMetadata openGraph.images = /og/docs/<slug>/image.png; the handler drops the trailing image.png segment before source.getPage(slug.slice(0, -1)) and exports generateStaticParams returning slugs + 'image.png' (Fumadocs next-og template). app/llms.txt/route.ts and app/llms-full.txt/route.ts (Fumadocs getLLMText pattern), both excluding design-history. No vercel.json. Version banner "These docs track main. Latest release: v<version>." from ../package.json read with fs. Frontmatter schema adds optional claims: string[] and placeholder: boolean. Mermaid component + remarkMdxMermaid.
4. Scripts exactly as §3.3 (dev, build, start, gen, check, check:site, lint:links, test). No postbuild/prebuild. gen/check may point at files T-DOCS-GEN creates; create website/scripts/check-all.mjs that skips missing sub-checks with a notice.
5. Create every page and meta.json in the §4 tree as placeholders (frontmatter title + placeholder: true, body "This page is being written."). Root and folder meta.json pages arrays exactly as §4. Design-history placeholders also contain the callout text "Historical, superseded". Remove all scaffold sample pages.
6. Write website/scripts/ia.json (the §4 tree), check-ia.mjs (§7.10, incl. --no-placeholders), check-site.mjs (§7.11 a–g; (a) maps the root index entry to /docs; (a)/(b) do not follow redirects, a 3xx such as the trailing-slash 308 is a failure; build first, spawn node_modules/.bin/next start -H 127.0.0.1 -p <--port, default 4310>, poll / up to 60 s, fetch only 127.0.0.1 URLs, kill the server in finally), with tests under website/scripts/test/ (passing and failing fixtures). Write website/README.md including an "Expected peer warnings" section naming takumi-js, vite, rolldown, satteri.
7. Root .gitignore: website/.next/, website/node_modules/, website/.source/, website/.vercel/. website/README.md also gets a line `DOCS_URL: <to be recorded by the owner>` (the owner replaces it with the Vercel production URL, AC28) and a short "Deployment" section: Vercel GitHub integration, Root Directory website/, Node 22.x (resolved from engines.node), Ignored Build Step `git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- .`, Vercel check never required, no env vars (spec §8.1).
8. test/packaging.test.mjs: assert the npm pack --dry-run --json --ignore-scripts file list has no website/ path and nothing under docs/ except docs/calibration/.
9. Prepend a "Superseded by .adlc/specs/docs-site.md" banner within the first 5 lines of docs/fumadocs-plan.md (no other edits to it).

This is a docs ticket: do not edit code or bundles — git diff --quiet origin/main -- lib bin mcp hooks sidecars scripts dist vendor; echo $? must print 0 (AC3). Do not edit AGENTS.md (AC23) or anything under .github/ (AC27). Do not hardcode test or dependency counts (N6). Every claim you write about behavior must be re-read in source at tag v1.0.0; record claim ids from spec §6 in the page frontmatter `claims:` and link each with a https://github.com/voodootikigod/antigravity-booster/blob/v1.0.0/<path>#L<n> permalink whose link text is the id, e.g. [C4](...) (D11). If code disagrees with §6, code wins; say which row was wrong in the PR description.

Context: repo antigravity-booster (agb), plugin v1.0.0. Spec: .adlc/specs/docs-site.md (revision 3: Vercel hosting, default Next.js server output) — read it first; section references below point into it. Use Node >= 22.19.0. Work on a branch off origin/main; never push to or merge into main (merge is the owner's decision).

Hard constraints: never modify .adlc/config.json (including acknowledgedNewRailBypass / trustedCodeownersAttested), lib/lock.mjs, lib/gates.mjs or CODEOWNERS (these are this ticket's rails). 

Resolved ambiguities:
- Base: origin/main 4864376 (no prerequisite).
- Placeholder frontmatter: `title:` = the §4 page label (folder index pages use the folder label), `description:` = the §4 one-line note for that page (or omit if none), `placeholder: true`. Placeholders carry no `claims:` and no permalinks; D11 does not apply to placeholders. The landing page's install command is the README's current install line verbatim (no claims needed; it is not a behavior claim).
- §7.11(c) queries /api/search?query=rails-guard against pages as built; the rail-enforcement placeholder's description must contain the literal string `rails-guard` (e.g. "How CI rails-guard and the PreToolUse guard keep rails frozen") so (c) finds a result.
- ia.json format: `{"pages": [...]}` mirroring meta.json exactly: each folder is `{"dir": "<name>", "pages": [...]}` with entries in §4 order, separators (e.g. `---Getting Started---`) stored as strings; check-ia compares order too.
- lint:links: script `node scripts/lint-links.mjs`, which uses next-validate-link's scanURLs + validateFiles over content/docs/**/*.mdx and exits 1 on any error. This is the only §3.3 script value that is a file you write.
- Version banner goes in app/layout.tsx (root layout) so the HTML served at / contains it.
- Search: use fumadocs-core 16.17.1 `createSearchAPI('advanced', { indexes })` with the exact index shape in spec §3.1 (verified present in 16.17.1 types); do NOT use `createFromSource`. If a field name is rejected by the type definitions, adapt and name the change in the PR description.
- Mermaid: follow the Fumadocs docs "Mermaid" recipe for 16.x (client component using mermaid + next-themes `useTheme().resolvedTheme` to pick 'dark'/'default'); remarkMdxMermaid from `fumadocs-core/mdx-plugins`, registered in source.config.ts. Fenced ```mermaid blocks are the authoring syntax.
- Dependencies: anything imported at runtime by app code (incl. lucide-react if the scaffold uses it) goes in dependencies; build tooling (tailwind, postcss, typescript, @types/*, biome) in devDependencies. After scaffolding, overwrite every version to the exact pins, delete node_modules and package-lock.json, run `npm install`, and commit the new lockfile.
- check-all.mjs (this ticket's version): runs check-ia (7.10) and, for each of check-schema-drift, check-stale-claims, check-evidence, check-known-issues, `gen-reference.mjs --check`, prints `skip: <script> not present` if the file is missing; exits 0 when all present checks pass (also when only check-ia is present).
- Check-script fixtures: every check script takes `--root <dir>` (default: repo root / website as appropriate); fixtures live in website/scripts/test/fixtures/<check>/{pass,fail}/; check-site tests use a tiny fixture HTTP server (node:http on 127.0.0.1) via a `--base-url` test hook instead of next start, with pass and fail responses and their own package.json for the version.
- Packaging: add a new test() case in test/packaging.test.mjs reusing the existing pack result; root package.json files already lists only docs/calibration/ under docs/, so it passes without editing package.json.
- §7.11(b): if a root-relative href/src 404s on next start, fix the page or config rather than relaxing the check; if impossible, stop and report.
- If create-fumadocs-app or a pinned version is unavailable, stop and ask the owner (needs network; root tests stay offline).

Conventions (apply to every page you write):
- Frontmatter `claims:` is a YAML list of id strings, e.g. `claims: [C4, C21]`. Pages with no §6 row assigned omit `claims:`. Other behavior statements on any page still get a blob/v1.0.0/<path>#L<n> permalink with descriptive link text (no id). One permalink per claim id is the minimum; add more when one id covers several facts on different lines.
- Rows citing only a file (no line) mean: find the line yourself at v1.0.0 (`git show v1.0.0:<path> | grep -n ...`).
- A fact that landed after v1.0.0 (e.g. CI rails-guard reading .adlc/tickets/, #87, commit a99b3cd, not an ancestor of v1.0.0) is linked at blob/a99b3cd/... instead, and the PR description says so. Do not revert docs to pre-#87 behavior.
- Known-issue markup: `<Callout type="warn" title="Known issue (T-CODE-FIXES-AUDIT item N)">one-paragraph description</Callout>` (fumadocs-ui default MDX component; the title text is exact).
- Historical markup: the first body element is `<Callout type="info" title="Historical, superseded">...</Callout>`.
- Internal links: root-relative, e.g. `/docs/reference/security` (no basePath; the site is served at the Vercel domain root). Repo files outside website/: https://github.com/voodootikigod/antigravity-booster/blob/main/<path> (no #L on blob/main links).
- Reading rail files (lib/gates.mjs, lib/lock.mjs) for evidence is allowed; editing them is not.
- Spec errors: never edit .adlc/specs/docs-site.md; list each wrong §6 row (and what code says) in the PR description.
- Content source order: code at v1.0.0, then the root doc named in §4/§5 at origin/main. Depth: cover every bullet in §4 for the page; done = those bullets covered with evidence and all checks pass.

Operational notes:
- Run commands from the repo root; lines beginning `cd website &&` run in a subshell, e.g. `(cd website && npm ci)`.
- `npm test` is the required gate. `unshare -r -n npm test` is informational: run it if user namespaces are available and paste the output; if unsupported, say so. `cd website && npm ci` needs network and is not run under unshare.
- AC30 `gate-manifest record` writes .adlc/manifest.jsonl, which is untracked at 4864376: do not commit it; paste the `verify` output. If record fails for environmental reasons (e.g. missing ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY), paste the error; it is an audit gate and does not block the PR (AGENTS.md degrade rule).
- The follow-up chore PR touches only .adlc/tickets/ and .adlc/ticket-archive/ (ticket complete/archive); it is not part of this ticket's scope.

Verification (run each, show output in the PR description):
- npm test (root suite passes; spec AC1, also try: unshare -r -n npm test)
- git diff --quiet origin/main -- .adlc/config.json; echo $?   -> 0 (AC29)
- npx adlc rails-guard --base origin/main --rails lib/lock.mjs --rails lib/gates.mjs --rails .adlc/config.json --rails CODEOWNERS; echo $?   -> 0 (AC22)
- npm test && npx adlc gate-manifest record tests --ticket T-DOCS-SCAFFOLD && npx adlc gate-manifest verify; echo $?   -> 0 (AC30)

- cd website && npm ci && npm run build && npm run check:site; echo $?   -> 0 (AC8, AC9; check:site starts next start on 127.0.0.1 and stays offline)
- cd website && npm run lint:links; echo $?   -> 0
- node website/scripts/check-ia.mjs; echo $?   -> 0 (AC13)
- node --test test/packaging.test.mjs; echo $?   -> 0 (AC2)
- AC4, AC5, AC6, AC7 commands from spec §11 (exact pins incl. react/react-dom 19.3.0, Node floor, server-output config with no basePath/export/vercel.json, .gitignore, peer note)
- cd website && npm test; echo $?   -> 0
- head -5 docs/fumadocs-plan.md | grep -ci superseded   -> >= 1

Finish: open a PR (not merged by you). After merge, in a follow-up chore PR, run npx adlc ticket complete T-DOCS-SCAFFOLD --write --authorize then npx adlc ticket archive T-DOCS-SCAFFOLD --write --authorize (AC31). Archive this ticket after merge.
title: Scaffold the Fumadocs site (Next.js server output for Vercel) in website/ with placeholders and running-site checks
